preconditions.description: The number of test cases q must be between 1 and 10000.
For each test case, the length of the string n and the length of the substring k must satisfy 1 <= k <= n <= 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist of exactly n characters, each being either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any(any(a[i] == b[i] for i in range(k)) for a in substrings) else 'YES'
postconditions.description: If no beautiful string exists, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the lexicographically smallest beautiful string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES\n' + min(t for t in candidates if all(any(t[i] == s[j+i] for j in range(n-k+1)) for i in range(k)))
postconditions.description: If a beautiful string exists, output 'YES' followed by the lexicographically smallest beautiful string that is bit similar to all substrings of length k.
